How to cite this data

“EU VAT rates via VatSnap (https://vatratefinder.com/data/), sourced from the European Commission TEDB, last verified 2026-08-23.” Rates change infrequently but do change — re-download before each filing season and confirm critical figures against the official EU source or your accountant.
